## Implemented route and limits

Production has an in-engine staged opening/skip; comforting pod services; C01–C04 records with provenance, observations and hypotheses; reef/island source contexts; transactional gathering, inventories and fabrication; actual restored workshop services; tools, 150 m suit, buoy and separate reserve cells; Dart control/holds/service; a bounded upper-Canopy laboratory and threat; survival/incapacity/local recovery rules; and persistent state. The separate seeded carrier fixture uses production state/controller/collision/save seams. Only actual M1 recipes/interactions are seeded. The seven regions, eight material IDs, six hull roles, carrier-independent future Creel route and complete campaign remain dependencies, not finished content.

Public M1 preparation + Dart costs remain the accepted candidate **16 alloy / 11 glass / 13 membrane**, 56 raw CU, including pod/workshop repairs, tools, suit, buoy and two reserve cells. Bobbin separately uses 2 alloy / 1 glass / 3 membrane from the protected 16/1/10 allocation. Exposed public stock is 52 alloy / 36 glass / 24 membrane / 28 crust / 36 resin plus 32 meals. Critical first materials have at least two patches. No candidate material quantities/yields were changed. The checker compares this implemented subset with the reference proposal; the proposal is never loaded by runtime.

## Exact contracts and migration proposals

Coordinator reconciliation is still required; this worker did not rewrite CONTRACTS.md.

- `CONTENT_VERSION = 'expedition.2'`; `SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2`. Same journal key/format, exclusive Web Lock, awaited detached snapshots, disposal/cancellation and request-scoped automatic-entry permission. No alternate runtime content authority or unlocked writer was introduced.
- `src/sim/types.ts` is the exact plain structure: `PlayerState`, `ItemStack`, `ContainerState`, `Finding`, `VehicleState`, `BerthTransaction`, `CarrierState`, `GameState`, `GameCommand`, `GameEvent`, `WorldQueries`. New state owns opening, identified containers/items/fittings, persistent plans/crafted history/provenance, depletion/facilities/maintenance/threat/actions, fleet investment/cargo/berths, recovery operation/caches/losses and route metrics. Scenario distinguishes `'expedition'` from `'carrier-fixture'`.
- Registry additions: `ITEMS`, `BLUEPRINTS`, `RECIPES`, `SOURCES`, `EVIDENCE`, `OPTIONAL_RECORD`, `HULL_COLLIDERS`, `DART_BUILD_POSE`, `RECOVERY_STAGE`, `CANOPY_COVER`, `THREAT_HOME`, `OPENING`; typed `ItemKind`, `BlueprintId`, `FacilityId`, `Recipe`, `RecipeId`, `SourceDefinition`, `SourceId`, `EvidenceId`. Existing region/material/hull IDs are stable.
- `stepGame(state, commands, world)` and `executeCommand(state, command, world)` both return `{state, events}`; the latter validates menu transactions without advancing simulation. App is the composition/lifecycle owner. UI sends commands, never mutates simulation state.
- `createWorldQueries(solids = SOLIDS)` now includes `clearance(origin, capsule): boolean`. `hullFloor(world, origin, shape)`, `hullClearance(world, origin, shape)` and `moveHull(world, origin, delta, shape)` share eight footprint-edge samples plus centre and swept solids. `FACILITY_SOLIDS` shares equipment/cradle geometry with art. Hull footprints are conservative upright envelopes, not oriented detailed collision meshes.
- Dart build pose changed `(20,-1.6,-24)` → `(20,-1.6,-22)` because its larger full footprint contacted the shallow shore. Amber rails now have actual shared colliders. Move north beyond z−18 before turning. This is geometry tuning, not an economy change. Dart radius3.6/height2.1, Creel4.5/3.6, Spindle4/1.7, Hearthline17/9.2; future hull envelopes remain proxies.
- Stable survival references: diver pose is capsule base, personal pressure base+0.4 m; airway base+0.85 m swimming or+1.55 m walking; hull pressure keel+0.5 m via `hullDepth(v)`. Renderer-interpolated eye height does not drive survival. Physical `inCanopyAir` works before C04 is read.
- `carrier.ts` exports `BERTH_LOCAL` (slots at x±3,y4,z1), `LAUNCH_LOCAL` (0,−3,−17), `CARRIER_SUPPORT` (65,−0.9,12), `atCarrierSupport`, `carrierInteriorSolids`, `launchPoint`, `localToWorld`, `worldToLocal`, `carrierHull`, `fixtureGame`, `carrierCommand`, `launchRefusal`, `updateBerth`. Attached poses are explicit carrier-local; independently owned world craft retain cargo/charge/damage. Prepared/lock transactions are saved and commit once or roll back. Spindle launch is surface-only, at world y−0.4. Walking underway is disabled.
- `recovery.ts` exports `disableVehicle`, `incapacitate`, `rescueWaypoints`, `recoveryCommand`, `updateRecovery`. Local staged M1 path is `(46,−12,−54) → (57,−9,−65) → (80,−47,−89) → visited disabled Dart`. The collar/tool is reusable. Capped bound repair credit (seven patches/hull) and recovery-only allocation never emit optional-spending raw stock. Salvage returns only the original public frame investment; used patches return to maintenance. Full deep Bobbin topology remains M2.
- `ExpeditionSession.newGame(scenario = 'expedition')` adds the explicit fixture choice. The accepted session/save lifecycle remains. `GameView` adds `PanelKind = 'inventory'|'craft'|'notebook'|'carrier'` and `UiActions.command(GameCommand)` plus panel/fixture/audio callbacks. `Soundscape` owns locally generated audio activation/update/events/dispose and `AudioSettings {volume,muted,subtitles}`.
- Renderer additions retain `createRenderer(canvas, availabilityChanged): GameRenderer`; content adapters include `createExpeditionArt(scene,cel): {update(state):void}`, `createEcology(scene,cel): AnimatedLife`, and `ArtBatch.bounds(Solid,color)`. Renderer consumes state; it cannot grant air/refuge, gather rewards or own depletion.
- Schema1 migration first validates the exact actual `foundation.1` shape. It initializes M1 once, completes opening/C01, preserves old tick/vitals/velocity/pose/mode when clear and relocates a newly covered pose to `(0,0.18,14)` with readable feedback. Read does not write; first successful replacement retains the prior raw generation. Future/malformed data is refused without replacement. Schema2 validates exact keys/known IDs, unique ownership/capacity/fitted equipment, research/prerequisites, source maxima, facility links, disabled-hull loss markers, exact berth transforms and transaction coherence. Codec validity does not prove every imported physical route safe.
